mechanics.fact: Isp holds INVITE to open Pac's inward entry; Pac holds LIFT to power the lift; Isp latches HANDOFF, freeing Pac and opening the lower return; Pac latches TURNAROUND to open Isp's upper passage; Isp latches STAIRS so Pac can return to the high exits. HANDOFF activates a boomerang that STAIRS interrupts.
